subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: The stranger said to the boy, "Can you tell me the way to the nearest hotel?" "Yes, sir, I can. Do you want a residential one in which you can spend the night?" said the boy. "I do not want to stay there but I only want a meal," replied the man. "Paradise Garden will be better for you," said the boy.
guide_solution: The stranger asked the boy whether he (b) could tell him (s) the way to the nearest hotel. The boy respectfully replied in the affirmative and said that he (b) could. He (b) asked him (s) whether he (s) wanted a residential one in which he (s) could spend the night. In reply the man told him (b) that he (s) did not want to stay there but he (s) only wanted a meal. Then the boy suggested that Paradise Garden would be better for him (s)
